ModMetaData.name: KMH Patch for RimWorld Together
ModMetaData.author: KNAPPE0
ModMetaData.description:
KMH is a community feature pack for the official RimWorld Together mod
It adds an in-game KMH tab with: - a player marketplace (buy/sell, search, guild-only listings) - timed auctions and a want-to-buy board - treasury vaults, personal and guild - a quest board: deliver, bounty, hunt, build, escort, defend, and custom quests - server-wide events and co-op/competitive global quests (Living World) - guilds with ranks, buyable perks, alliances, and a shared vault - a reputation system with quest-trust scoring - custom production sites with workers and reward routing - Server Standings: player, guild, colony, colonist, trade, battle, and site records with profiles and a season archive - offline mail for outcomes that happen while you're away - an optional Discord bridge
KMH only activates when you connect to a KMH-enabled server.
Client mod (this): https://github.com/KNAPPE0/KMH-Patch Server addon: https://github.com/KNAPPE0/KMH-Server-Addon
